wo du mit anpacken kannst

Gemeinsam mit Entwicklung und Betrieb setzt Du die hohen Compliance- und Datenschutzanforderungen des Gesundheitssektors technisch sauber um – denn Datenhoheit ist bei uns kein Nebenschauplatz, sondern Teil unseres Fundaments.

Diese Position kann zu 100 % aus dem Homeoffice ausgeübt werden.

Die europäische Industrie verliert an Wettbewerbsfähigkeit, weil Strom hier teurer und volatiler ist als in den USA oder China. Der Grund: Erneuerbare schwanken stark – Fabriken verbrauchen konstant.

Unser Projektportfolio wächst schnell – und mit ihm die Projektierungs- und Umsetzungsarbeit-Arbeit hinter jedem Batteriespeicherprojekt: Planung, Netzanschluss, Dokumentation, Tools. Du siehst dabei den kompletten Lebenszyklus eines Industriespeicherprojekts: von der Auslegung über den Netzanschluss bis zur Inbetriebnahme.

description:
La mission en bref
Mission freelance de 6 mois, renouvelable par périodes de 3 ou 6 mois, dans la limite de 24 mois au total. Démarrage dès que possible, sous réserve de finalisation de la consultation.
Intervention à Saint-Denis ou à Cesson-Sévigné, avec au moins 3 jours par semaine sur site. Le travail hors site est possible à la demande du client.
Contexte de la mission
Pour un grand groupe de télécommunications qui construit une plateforme de cloud souverain, vous coordonnez les livraisons de plusieurs équipes produit qui développent des services cloud, data et IA. Vous travaillez avec les équipes chargées des fondations techniques de la plateforme pour anticiper les dépendances, fiabiliser les engagements et faciliter les arbitrages.
Vos missions
Installer et animer les rituels de synchronisation, les planifications et les revues d’incrément. Consolider les engagements et les jalons des équipes dans une feuille de route commune.

Identifier les dépendances, les risques et les blocages. Faciliter leur résolution avec les équipes, préparer les arbitrages et suivre les décisions jusqu’à leur mise en œuvre.

This is an Atlantic porfolio company.

The opportunity
Demand for AI compute is outrunning the infrastructure to deliver it, and the environmental bill is growing with it: more fossil power, more freshwater, more land. New capacity on land also means waiting years for power, sites and permits.
We take a different route: we bring compute to the power. Far offshore, the wind blows stronger and steadier than anywhere on land, and no grid will ever reach it. Using it lets AI scale without adding carbon or competing with communities and nature for water and land.
We're building fleets of autonomous ships that turn that wind into AI compute at sea. Each ship carries its own wind turbines and computing on board, and navigates on its own across the open ocean, following the strongest and steadiest winds. No mooring, no cables to shore: the fleet goes where the energy is. It's AI infrastructure built from the ground up for the open ocean, from power systems and autonomy to high-density computing, engineered to run in one of the harshest environments on Earth. No grid queue. No freshwater. No land. Zero-carbon compute that scales with the fleet.
Firm, low-carbon power at a target cost of ~€50/MWh, one of the biggest costs in running AI compute

70%+ capacity factor: offshore wind that behaves like baseload

summary: Dates : 6 mois à partir de février ou mars 2027 Contexte du projet : L’allègement des structures automobiles reste un levier majeur pour réduire la consommation et les émissions des véhicules, tout…
description:
Dates : 6 mois à partir de février ou mars 2027
Contexte du projet :
L’allègement des structures automobiles reste un levier majeur pour réduire la consommation et les émissions des véhicules, tout en répondant à des exigences croissantes de rigidité et de tenue au crash. Les pièces de caisse en blanc sont en grande majorité réalisées à partir de tôles d’acier mises en forme, dont la conception repose encore largement sur l’expertise et sur des itérations successives entre calcul et dessin.
L’optimisation topologique permet de déterminer la meilleure répartition de matière dans un domaine de conception donné. Appliquée à un domaine volumique 3D, elle conduit cependant à des structures massives ou de type treillis, difficilement transposables en pièces embouties d’épaisseur quasi constante. Le défi scientifique consiste à formuler une méthode capable de faire émerger, à partir d’un domaine volumique, des géométries représentatives de tôles (structures à parois minces), en maîtrisant l’épaisseur et la fabricabilité, sous chargements statiques puis dynamiques.
Ce stage s’inscrit dans le cadre d’une collaboration de recherche entre le LTDS et ArcelorMittal Global R&D. Il a vocation à se poursuivre par une thèse CIFRE en cas de résultats concluants.
L’objectif du stage sera de développer et d’évaluer une première méthodologie d’optimisation topologique 3D aboutissant à une solution en tôle d’acier, en s’appuyant sur une structure automobile.

summary: Our Mission At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous…
description:
Our Mission
At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient.
We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today!

The Role
You will be the first engineer on our Simulation team. Every site we map becomes a digital twin, built from our own lidar maps, and in it our robots see thousands of the intrusions, fires and sensor failures a real site sees once a year. Our multi-robot patrol policy was trained in simulation in under two hours on a single GPU and ran unmodified on real robots at three sites. Your job is to make that repeatable for every site and every new skill.
You will work with our Skills & Orchestration engineers, who train learned skills with reinforcement learning, and with our Reliability & Test Infrastructure engineer, who runs regression in the same simulator.

What You'll Work On
Map to twin: a pipeline from our lidar maps to simulation-ready digital twins: geometry, semantics, materials,…

summary: Our Mission At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous…

Our Mission

We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today!

The Role
You will own the research question at the centre of LEA, our foundation model of the physical world: can a model learn what normally happens on a site, by place, hour and weather, so that an anomaly is simply what it did not expect? The first version is a probabilistic memory of each site. The next is a world model across every site that predicts the next state in latent space, starting from open world-model weights and growing on field data nobody else holds.
Our robots and cameras run on live security sites around the clock, and every event is kept with its clip, the model's verdict and the operator's outcome. That record is your dataset. You will work alongside our perception and model engineers, and your results go into production, not only into papers.

description:
Gravis Robotics is a high-growth Series A start-up backed by SoftBank, bringing Physical AI to the construction industry, turning heavy construction machines into autonomous robots. 

Gravis began as an ETH Zurich spin-out, and our unique combination of learning-based automation and augmented remote control lets one operator safely conduct a fleet of earthmoving machines in a gamified environment. 

Backed by deep robotics research and now deployed across multiple countries with leading construction and equipment partners, our team is rapidly growing to bring this technology to a trillion-dollar industry. 

The Gravis RACK is a machine-agnostic retrofit kit that adds autonomy to excavators and wheel loaders from 10 to 100+ tonnes: LiDAR and camera sensing, GNSS RTK, networking hardware and rugged edge compute that works offline. Paired with the Slate tablet and our Copilot software, it lets an operator run a machine manually, with AI assistance, or fully autonomously.  

About the Job

The autonomy team at Gravis builds autonomous systems for excavators operating in real construction environments. You will build control modules that run on many different machines, across many sites, with different soil conditions. We’re looking for a roboticist with data driven planning and/or control background, deep python expertise and good level of C++ proficiency.

title: Stage Privacy & Data
summary: Ben jij een student die energie krijgt van processen doorgronden en puzzels oplossen, met interesse in privacy en data? Wil je bijdragen aan een duurzamere wereld en zien hoe nieuwe wetgeving landt…
description:
Ben jij een student die energie krijgt van processen doorgronden en puzzels oplossen, met interesse in privacy en data? Wil je bijdragen aan een duurzamere wereld en zien hoe nieuwe wetgeving landt in een snel groeiend bedrijf? Dan is MyWheels op zoek naar jou!

Over MyWheels
MyWheels gelooft in een toekomst waarin je mobiliteit inricht op wat je écht nodig hebt, niet op wat je bezit. Toegang tot de juiste auto, op het juiste moment. Wij bouwen het platform dat dat mogelijk maakt.

Als grootste elektrische mobiliteitsplatform van Nederland gaan we verder dan toegang tot een auto. Via Vehicle-to-Grid (V2G) leveren onze elektrische auto’s ook stroom terug aan het energienet. Zo pakken we tegelijk de netcongestie aan en bouwen we aan de energie- én mobiliteitsvoorziening van de toekomst. ⚡

Vanuit ons kantoor in Amsterdam werkt een enthousiast team van zo’n 50 mensen aan dit platform. Samen bouwen we aan iets wat echt telt.

Wat ga je doen?
Als stagiair Privacy & Data ondersteun je ons bij het verder brengen van ons privacy-programma in de breedste zin van het woord. Je werkt mee aan onze processen en verwerkingen, en verdiept je in de Leidraad Data Delen van de ACM, die praktische richtlijnen geeft over hoe de Europese Data Act door Nederlandse bedrijven moet worden uitgevoerd. Je werkt nauw samen met onze Security Lead, die je begeleidt, en kunt steunen op zijn contacten met onze Functionaris Gegevensbescherming en de Legal Counsel van onze moedermaatschappij.

description:
At Graviton, we don't believe the best trading strategies come from following established playbooks. They come from asking better questions. Why does a pattern exist? What is driving it? Is it real or just noise? Can it be explained, modelled and turned into an edge?

As a Quantitative Researcher, you'll work on those questions every day. You'll investigate market behaviour, develop quantitative models, build and test hypotheses and turn insights into trading strategies, working alongside researchers and technologists in an environment where an idea on a whiteboard can reach live trading quickly.

This isn't a role where the answers are in a textbook. The problems are open-ended, the data is enormous, and finding the answers is the job.

Ideal candidates are rigorous thinkers who genuinely enjoy mathematics, programming and figuring out things that aren't obvious, based in our Singapore, London, Amsterdam or US offices.

What You'll Work On

You'll work across quantitative research and systematic trading, taking ideas through the full lifecycle: question, hypothesis, experiment, model, validation, strategy, production. Depending on your team and research interests, your work would include:

Discovering predictive patterns and sources of alpha from billions of market events

Formulating hypotheses about market behaviour and designing experiments to test them

Applying probability, statistics, optimization and machine learning to build predictive models and quantitative…

Ability to write high-performance production quality code.

Team player, a good communicator and a fast learner.

Full-Time position

Competitive salary depending on experience

Medical, dental & vision insurance

Open vacation policy

401(K)

Transportation allowance

A Relaxing, stress-free work environment

description:
We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era.

When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done.

Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma.

We’re building an AI scientist for our customers. We can’t do that if we haven’t built the muscle ourselves. AI fluency is the foundation we build on; it's core to how we work, and we're committed to helping every new hire integrate it into their day-to-day. As part of our interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today.

title: Content Reviewer - United States
summary: Every search represents someone seeking reliable information. They depend on search results being accurate, trustworthy, and relevant to their local context. But search engines only learn to return…
description:
Every search represents someone seeking reliable information. They depend on search results being accurate, trustworthy, and relevant to their local context. But search engines only learn to return trustworthy information if human evaluators with deep research expertise and cultural knowledge verify and correct them. Your linguistic precision, fact-checking rigor, and understanding of how your culture communicates and values information is irreplaceable in building search systems that people can actually trust.

In this role, you will evaluate search queries, results, and AI-generated content for factual accuracy, authority, relevance, and user intent alignment. Your judgment determines whether search systems return trustworthy, contextually appropriate information.

Analyze multi-turn search queries and web results for factual accuracy, source authority, and user intent alignment

Conduct cross-referencing and fact-checking using regional sources, specialized databases, academic resources, and web directories

Open Issuance is central to that opportunity. Built by Bridge, a Stripe company, it enables businesses to launch and manage their own stablecoins. Engineering at Privy is distinguished by:

High urgency—Shipping very small iterations, very fast, to learn very quickly. 

Product taste—Our customers are developers, and to build effective products for them requires technical knowledge —you will often be "the PM".

Security mindset—A great portion of our product is trust. While we have a dedicated security team, every engineer brings security to their designs from the start.

Who we are

About Privy

Our mission is to make privacy and user ownership the default online. To do so, we build simple, flexible APIs and tools for developers that make it easy to build new products on crypto rails.

Privy owns the abstractions and infrastructure layer above wallets, integrating across chains, third-party providers, and Stripe products like Treasury and Link. We get to solve hard technical problems while leveraging Stripe's distribution to reach customers like Ramp, Klarna, Deel, Kraken, Hyperliquid, and Fomo — powering experiences for both mainstream users and crypto natives.

About the team

Engineering at Privy is distinguished by

High urgency—Shipping very small iterations, very fast, to learn very quickly

Product taste—Our customers are developers, and to build effective products for them requires technical knowledge—you will often be "the PM."

Security mindset—A great portion of our product is trust. While we have a dedicated security team, every engineer brings security to their designs from the start.

In practice, we use boring technology like Node, React, and AWS so we can focus our engineering energy entirely on pushing the boundaries of Privy's core product, e.g. through hardware enclaves, multi-region low latency APIs, and blockchain abstractions that are accessible to mainstream developers.

About Bridge

Bridge is building a new payments platform powered by stablecoins to make global money movement simpler, faster, and more accessible. Through our APIs, businesses can send and receive funds across borders, give customers access to dollars through virtual accounts, and disburse USD globally.

We believe stablecoin rails will become a foundational part of financial infrastructure, moving and settling trillions of dollars worldwide. Bridge is helping bring that future forward.

Our team has built financial infrastructure at companies including Coinbase, Stripe, Square, Brex, Upstart, DoorDash, and Airbnb. We are united by the conviction that stablecoins can materially improve how money moves around the world.

Build and ship end-to-end product experiences across frontend applications, backend services, APIs, and data systems.

Develop and maintain the APIs and backend systems that power global payments, virtual accounts, and payouts.

Who we are

About Privy

Our mission is to make privacy and user ownership the default online. To do so, we build simple, flexible APIs and tools for developers that make it easy to build new products on crypto rails.

Privy owns the abstractions and infrastructure layer above wallets, integrating across chains, third-party providers, and Stripe products like Treasury and Link. We get to solve hard technical problems while leveraging Stripe's distribution to reach customers like Ramp, Klarna, Deel, Kraken, Hyperliquid, and Fomo — powering experiences for both mainstream users and crypto natives.

Learn more about Privy: Privy and Stripe: Bringing crypto to everyone

About the team

Engineering at Privy is distinguished by:

High urgency: Shipping very small iterations, very fast, to learn very quickly. 

Product taste: Our customers are developers, and to build effective products for them requires technical knowledge - you will often be "the PM".

Security mindset: A great portion of our product is trust. While we have a dedicated security team, every engineer brings security to their designs from the start.

In practice, we use boring technology like Node, React, and AWS so we can focus our engineering energy entirely on pushing the boundaries of Privy's core product, e.g. through hardware enclaves, multi-region low latency APIs, and blockchain abstractions that are accessible to mainstream developers.

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a technology company focused on improving the conditions for economic growth and prosperity. We build programmable financial infrastructure, rethinking from first principles how financial services should work, to make it easier and cheaper for any business to start and scale. More than 10 million businesses build on Stripe, spanning the economic frontier—from solo founders to established enterprises—united by a practical focus on growth. Recruiting depends on systems that work reliably for recruiters, hiring managers, interviewers, and candidates. The Recruiting Systems Operations Administrator helps keep those systems running and improves the support experience around them.

You’ll work closely with Recruiting Operations, Global People Operations, and People Systems. This role supports a clear division of work between routine service delivery and the system governance, integrations, complex configuration, and strategic work owned by Recruiting Systems.

description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a technology company focused on improving the conditions for economic growth and prosperity. We build programmable financial infrastructure, rethinking from first principles how financial services should work, to make it easier and cheaper for any business to start and scale. More than 10 million businesses build on Stripe, spanning the economic frontier—from solo founders to established enterprises—united by a practical focus on growth. The most ambitious companies in the world use Stripe as core infrastructure to grow faster. They process trillions of dollars a year on Stripe, equivalent to around 1.6% of global GDP. While economic growth makes everyone better off, open markets also enable greater variety. When any business can easily serve a global customer base, the quality and diversity of products in the world increase, and craft and creativity are unleashed into the smallest niches. Our own growth is wholly contingent on the success of the businesses building on Stripe. We therefore invest back into our technology at an unusual rate. We make upgrades to our products every single day to deliver compounding gains to our customers. We maintain some of the most reliable APIs on the internet. We build entirely new pieces of financial infrastructure to enable new ideas. And our significant advances in risk and fraud infrastructure over many years are making the internet economy safer and more accessible.

Though people at Stripe don’t…

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet.

Stripe Apps connect Stripe with the tools businesses already use, bringing relevant data and workflows into the Stripe Dashboard and third-party systems. The Strategic Apps team owns a portfolio of integrations with enterprise systems that are critical to our users’ workflows—from quote-to-cash and support to reporting. We help users embed Stripe more deeply into the way they run their businesses.

What you’ll do

We’re looking for a Staff Product Manager to set the strategy and lead execution for Strategic Apps. You will own a portfolio of existing and new integrations, including those with systems such as Salesforce, and determine where Stripe should invest based on user needs, Stripe’s product and industry priorities, and market signals. You will work across Stripe and directly with external partners to deliver reliable, high-quality integrations that drive adoption and business outcomes.

Own the vision, product strategy, roadmap, and success metrics for a portfolio of strategic apps, making and communicating clear trade-offs amid significant ambiguity.

Platforms, connected accounts, and their customers each have different relationships with Stripe, access levels, and responsibilities. Resolving an issue often requires understanding who owns the account, which permissions apply, how products are configured, and which party should provide support.

The team is building the foundations for more contextual support across this multi-party ecosystem. A key part of the work is improving Stripe’s customer-facing AI agent so it can understand these relationships, handle complex cases, and provide accurate, personalized resolutions at scale.

Whether a user is building a superb retail experience, extending their website to a pop-up store, or enabling mobile point-of-sale payments at their next event, Terminal gives them the building blocks to do it.

Almost every Terminal experience starts with a developer building the integration. The Developer Experiences team owns that work: the SDKs, APIs, integration primitives, documentation, and example apps that developers—and, increasingly, AI agents—use to build on Terminal. Who we are 

About Privy

Our mission is to make privacy and user ownership the default online. To do so, we build simple, flexible APIs and tools for developers that make it easy to build new products on crypto rails.

Privy owns the abstractions and infrastructure layer above wallets, integrating across chains, third-party providers, and Stripe products like Treasury and Link. We get to solve hard technical problems while leveraging Stripe's distribution to reach customers like Ramp, Klarna, Deel, Kraken, Hyperliquid, and Fomo — powering experiences for both mainstream users and crypto natives.

Learn more about Privy: Privy and Stripe: Bringing crypto to everyone

About the team

Engineering at Privy is distinguished by:

High urgency: Shipping very small iterations, very fast, to learn very quickly. 

Product taste: Our customers are developers, and to build effective products for them requires technical knowledge - you will often be "the PM".

Security mindset: A great portion of our product is trust. While we have a dedicated security team, every engineer brings security to their designs from the start.

In practice, we use boring technology like Node, React, and AWS so we can focus our engineering energy entirely on pushing the boundaries of Privy's core product, e.g. through hardware enclaves, multi-region low latency APIs, and blockchain abstractions that are accessible to mainstream developers.

About the team

The Stripe Security team is dedicated to improving the security of Stripe and its users. Our users trust us with some of their most sensitive information, and we make security a first-class consideration in everything we do. Security concerns are ever-evolving, creating an extremely dynamic environment for the Security team.

The Security Governance, Risk, and Compliance (SGRC) team helps Stripe make informed security decisions, understand its risk and control posture, and represent its security program to internal and external stakeholders. The team also manages security risk arising from Stripe’s relationships with third parties by assessing their security controls, identifying and mitigating risk, and supporting informed onboarding and risk-acceptance decisions. Who we are
About Bridge

We're creating an entirely new payments platform, built with stablecoins, to simplify global money movement. Bridge enables faster, cheaper payments and borderless access to dollars via stablecoins. Through our APIs, businesses can send and receive funds across borders faster and cheaper vs. SWIFT and other fiat-only rails. Our virtual accounts enable international consumers and businesses to easily access, store, and spend US dollars. Our payouts infrastructure enables platforms to disburse USD to anyone globally. We believe many trillions of dollars will move and settle through stablecoin payment rails. Bridge is pulling this future forward.

We have a small team of people who have previously built financial infrastructure at some of the world's leading companies (Coinbase, Stripe, Square, Brex, Upstart, DoorDash, Airbnb), and each and every one of them chose Bridge because they fundamentally believe that stablecoins will be a critical piece of financial infrastructure that allows for the improvement of global money movement.

The Metronome Infrastructure team builds and operates the infrastructure that Metronome product teams use to help users model and run their businesses. description:
Who we are

About Privy

Our mission is to make privacy and user ownership the default online. To do so, we build simple, flexible APIs and tools for developers that make it easy to build new products on crypto rails.

Privy owns the abstractions and infrastructure layer above wallets, integrating across chains, third-party providers, and Stripe products like Treasury and Link. We get to solve hard technical problems while leveraging Stripe's distribution to reach customers like Ramp, Klarna, Deel, Kraken, Hyperliquid, and Fomo — powering experiences for both mainstream users and crypto natives.

Learn more about Privy: Privy and Stripe: Bringing crypto to everyone

About the team

Engineering at Privy is distinguished by:

High urgency: Shipping very small iterations, very fast, to learn very quickly. 

Product taste: Our customers are developers, and to build effective products for them requires technical knowledge - you will often be "the PM".

Metronome is the leading usage-based billing platform built for modern software companies. With Metronome, now a Stripe product, companies can launch products faster, offer any pricing model, and streamline finance workflows without writing code.

You'll be joining Stripe and be part of the holistic Stripe platform approaching monetization.

The Metronome AI Native Solutions team operates at the intersection of technical sales, implementation, and customer success, purpose-built for the velocity and unique needs of AI-first companies.
